titulo: California beaches close as record-breaking tides and major flooding loom
cuerpo: Most of state likely to avoid worst-case scenario of coastal flooding amplified by intense winter rainstorms Major flooding is expected in California today as a second day of record-breaking high tides hits up and down the west coast. While forecasts suggest most of the state is on track to avoid the worst-case scenario – coastal flooding amplified by intense winter rainstorms – local officials have been preparing for weeks for the risk that flooding will disrupt travel during Thanksgiving week, one of the busiest times of the year.
